hunks.baseline: Great Sir’s final mutterings, heard only by the desert and the darkness, had been half right and half wrong.
hunks.sol: Great Sir’s final mutter, heard only by the desert and the darkness, had been half right and half wrong.

hunks.baseline: As the dusky dawn mist receded and the first light began to spread, the sky unleashed a downpour with all its might, as if it had been waiting for this moment.
hunks.sol: As the dim dawn mist receded and the first light began to spread, the sky unleashed a downpour with all its might, as if it had been waiting for this moment.

hunks.baseline: Torrential rain poured down. Before the fierce wind and rain, people pulled their collars tight and lowered their rain capes over their heads. The beasts carrying them let out weary cries.
hunks.sol: Rain came down in sheets. People pulled their collars tight and their straw rain capes close against the fierce wind and rain. The beasts carrying them let out weary cries.

hunks.baseline: At the deep voice from beneath an oil-treated bamboo hat, the young man riding slowly at his right spoke up.
hunks.sol: At the deep voice from beneath an oil-treated bamboo hat, the young man riding slowly to the speaker’s right spoke up.

hunks.baseline: “We’re lucky they’ve held out this long. We’ll be clear of this wretched plateau in half a day, so we have no choice but to hang on a little longer.”
hunks.sol: “We’re lucky they’ve held out this long. We’ll be clear of this wretched plateau in half a day, so we’ll just have to keep going a little longer.”

hunks.baseline: The man in the bamboo hat couldn’t help agreeing with the young man’s choice of words.
In fact, he was certain that not only he, but tens of thousands of martial artists trudging forward at that very moment, felt the same way.
hunks.sol: The man in the bamboo hat couldn’t help agreeing. He was certain the tens of thousands of martial artists trudging forward at that very moment felt the same way.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. It’s been a hard road.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. It hasn’t been easy.”

hunks.baseline: The man in the bamboo hat muttered to himself and remembered what he’d seen on the way here.
hunks.sol: He murmured the words to himself, remembering what he’d seen on the way here.

hunks.baseline: Dry riverbeds and dead forests.
hunks.sol: Dry rivers and dead forests.

hunks.baseline: Every well was foul. They’d searched the surroundings thoroughly, but found no people—not even the carcass of a common gnat.
hunks.sol: Every well was rotten. They’d searched the surrounding areas thoroughly, but found no people—not even the corpse of a common flying insect.

hunks.baseline: As if nothing had ever lived there at all.
hunks.sol: As if none had ever existed in the first place.

hunks.baseline: The man in the bamboo hat thought again of the question that had long gone unanswered. But he already knew that no matter how deeply he pondered it, he’d only be wasting his mental strength.
hunks.sol: The question had troubled him all this time. But he already knew that thinking about it any harder would only be a waste of mental effort.

preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: If he could have figured it out on his own, then the white-haired old man approaching now with a nod of greeting would surely have done so as well.
hunks.sol: If it were something he could figure out on his own, the white-haired old man approaching now with a nod of greeting would surely have figured it out too.

hunks.baseline: “Family Head Jin, you’re being so formal that this old man hardly knows where to put himself. Just call me Chief.”
hunks.sol: “Family Head Jin, such formality leaves this old man hardly knowing what to do with himself. Just call me Chief.”

hunks.baseline: The man in the bamboo hat—no, Jin Wikyung—shook his head awkwardly.
hunks.sol: The man in the bamboo hat—Jin Wikyung—shook his head awkwardly.

hunks.baseline: “Little brother.”
hunks.sol: “Second.”

hunks.baseline: The second young master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, the Heaven Shaking Sword, Jin Mukyung, replied, “Who’s your little brother?”
hunks.sol: The Second Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, Jin Mukyung—the Heaven Shaking Sword—replied, “Who are you calling Second?”

hunks.baseline: “Pick some men and search the surrounding area. No—Commander, please see to it. I need to speak privately with Great Hero Song.”
hunks.sol: “Choose some men and search the surrounding area. No—Commander, please see to it. I need to speak privately with Great Hero Song.”

hunks.baseline: “Commander Jin Mukyung acknowledges the Family Head’s orders.”
hunks.sol: “Commander Jin Mukyung accepts the Family Head’s order.”

hunks.baseline: “You…”
hunks.sol: “You…!”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t be too hard on him. From what I’ve heard, it’s good to see that the brothers are so close.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t be too hard on him. From what I’ve heard, you brothers are close. It’s good to see.”

hunks.baseline: “No, my younger brother needs a good scolding. He has no manners at all. Interrupting an elder while he’s speaking.”
hunks.sol: “No, my younger brother needs a good scolding. He has no manners at all, interrupting an elder while he’s speaking.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s pouring like this! I told him several times to use one, and he didn’t even listen! He didn’t even wear a bamboo hat!”
hunks.sol: “It’s pouring! I’ve told him over and over to use one, and he won’t listen! He didn’t even put on a bamboo hat!”

hunks.baseline: “I know he’s not going to lose his hair right this instant, but what if he catches a cold? What then, hm? Am I wrong?”
hunks.sol: “He won’t lose his hair right this instant, fine! But what if he catches a cold? What then, hm? Am I wrong?”

hunks.baseline: At Jin Wikyung’s sudden outburst, the Thousand-Faced Fox fell silent for a moment before replying.
hunks.sol: The Thousand-Faced Fox fell silent at Jin Wikyung’s sudden outburst before replying.

hunks.baseline: “When my younger brothers were little, they were frail. Taekyung must be having a hard time now, too. I worry whether he’s taking good care of himself.”
hunks.sol: “My younger brothers were frail when they were little. Taekyung must be having a hard time right now, too. I worry whether he’s taking care of himself.”

hunks.baseline: By this point, even the Thousand-Faced Fox was beginning to worry.
hunks.sol: By this point, the Thousand-Faced Fox was worried too.

hunks.baseline: He was starting to wonder whether there was something wrong with Jin Wikyung’s mind.
hunks.sol: Worried that there might be something wrong with Jin Wikyung’s mind.

hunks.baseline: Who was the Heaven Shaking Sword, Jin Mukyung?
hunks.sol: Who was Jin Mukyung, the Heaven Shaking Sword?

hunks.baseline: Since childhood, he’d been counted among the finest rising martial artists in Murim on the strength of his extraordinary talent alone. And after One-Ride Heavenly Dragon Murong Yeonghwi vanished with the downfall of his family, no one had denied Mukyung his place at the head of the Ten Dragons and Phoenixes.
hunks.sol: Since childhood, his extraordinary talent alone had placed him among Murim’s finest young prodigies. After One-Ride Heavenly Dragon Murong Yeonghwi vanished along with his family’s fortunes, no one had disputed Mukyung’s place at the head of the Ten Dragons and Phoenixes.

hunks.baseline: To be precise, he’d long since surpassed the level of a rising martial artist.
hunks.sol: To be precise, he had long since surpassed the level of a young prodigy.

hunks.baseline: In the recent Battle of Eight Spring Gorge, which decided the fate of the entire northern region, that young Sword Demon of the Jin Family of Taiyuan had defeated the Blood Soul Fat Demon, a great fiend of the previous generation, announcing the birth of a new Supreme Peak master to the world.
hunks.sol: At the recent Battle of Eight Spring Gorge, which decided the fate of the entire northern region, that young Sword Demon of the Jin Family of Taiyuan had defeated the Blood Soul Fat Demon, a great fiend of the previous generation. The whole world had witnessed the birth of a new Supreme Peak master.

hunks.baseline: And yet Jin Wikyung was worried he’d catch a cold.
hunks.sol: And Jin Wikyung was worried he’d catch a cold.

hunks.baseline: When he’d even brought up the monster among monsters, Jin Taekyung, the Thousand-Faced Fox had nearly been too dumbfounded to speak.
hunks.sol: When he brought up Jin Taekyung, that monster among monsters, the Thousand-Faced Fox nearly lost the power of speech altogether.

hunks.baseline: *Is he joking right now?*
hunks.sol: *Is he joking?*

hunks.baseline: The Thousand-Faced Fox briefly wondered whether he ought to laugh. Then, with the practiced skill of the Chief of the Hidden Shadow Pavilion, he kept his expression in check.
hunks.sol: He briefly wondered whether he ought to laugh. Then, with the practiced skill of the Chief of the Hidden Shadow Pavilion, he kept his expression in check.

hunks.baseline: “Young Hero Jin is doing well. Even if he’s run into a little trouble, I’m sure it’s nothing serious.”
hunks.sol: “Young Hero Jin will be fine. Even if he runs into a little trouble, I’m sure it won’t amount to much.”

hunks.baseline: “That part doesn’t worry me at all.”
hunks.sol: “On that score, I’m reassured.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung, who doted on his two younger brothers—and especially his youngest, who’d long been his sore spot—agreed with heartfelt sincerity for once.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung, who doted on both his younger brothers—and especially his youngest, who’d long been a source of worry to him—agreed with heartfelt sincerity.

hunks.baseline: The force they’d sent was tiny, given the terrain and the need for speed. But it included no fewer than six Supreme Peak masters, an elite force by any measure.
hunks.sol: The group sent across the desert was small, given the terrain and the need for speed. But it included no fewer than six Supreme Peak masters: an elite force by any measure.

hunks.baseline: Three of them were hardly inferior to Mae Jonghak, the current Alliance Leader of Murim. Even if a major threat arose, each of them should be more than capable of protecting himself.
hunks.sol: Three of them were hardly inferior to Mae Jonghak, the current Alliance Leader of Murim. Even if a major threat arose, they should each be capable of protecting themselves.

hunks.baseline: *The Big Man, was it?*
hunks.sol: *Great Sir, was it?*

hunks.baseline: He’d heard the rumors.
hunks.sol: He’d heard plenty of rumors.

hunks.baseline: The appearance of a new Supreme Peak master always drew the world’s attention, and that was no different even as Dark Heaven’s schemes shook the land.
hunks.sol: The appearance of a new Supreme Peak master always drew attention, even while Dark Heaven’s schemes shook the land.

hunks.baseline: If anything, the interest was greater.
hunks.sol: If anything, it drew more attention now.

hunks.baseline: A mysterious master who’d appeared in such troubled times, with wild hair and half his mind seemingly somewhere else?
hunks.sol: A mysterious master appearing in such troubled times, with wild hair and half his mind seemingly elsewhere?

hunks.baseline: A chivalrous hero who’d single-handedly crushed the mounted bandits running rampant in Gansu more than a decade ago?
hunks.sol: A chivalrous hero who’d crushed the mounted bandits running rampant in Gansu more than a decade ago, all in one stroke?

hunks.baseline: That was all it took.
The martial world’s gossips couldn’t resist. They talked about the Big Man until their mouths were dry, and rumors about him spread across the land.
hunks.sol: The martial world’s gossips couldn’t resist. They talked about Great Sir until their mouths were dry, and word of him spread across the land.

hunks.baseline: As the man responsible for leading a family, Jin Wikyung was cautious in all things—and when it came to his younger brothers’ safety, he was practically allergic to risk.
hunks.sol: As the man leading a family, Jin Wikyung was cautious in all things. When it came to his younger brothers’ safety, he left nothing to chance.

hunks.baseline: So of course he’d decided to meet the suspicious eccentric who’d joined his youngest brother’s group himself.
hunks.sol: Of course he’d wanted to meet the suspicious eccentric who’d joined his youngest brother’s group.

hunks.baseline: Though, in the end, he’d failed.
hunks.sol: Though, in the end, he hadn’t managed it.

hunks.baseline: The Big Man was like a wind blowing across the Great Steppe.
hunks.sol: Great Sir was like the wind on the Great Steppe.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung had seen him only briefly, standing beside Jin Taekyung atop the city wall. After that, he was always vanishing somewhere, then suddenly turning up somewhere else.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung had seen him only briefly, standing beside Jin Taekyung atop the city wall. After that, he was always vanishing somewhere and suddenly turning up somewhere else.

hunks.baseline: If the Big Man had ever gone missing for a while, Jin Wikyung might have seriously suspected he was a spy. But after conducting a fairly thorough investigation, he’d found that wasn’t the case.
hunks.sol: If Great Sir’s whereabouts had ever remained a mystery for long, Jin Wikyung might have seriously suspected him of being a spy. But his own fairly thorough investigation had ruled that out.

hunks.baseline: The Big Man made his presence known to the whole world with his booming shouts of nonsense and his foul stench.
hunks.sol: Great Sir announced his presence to the world with booming nonsense and a foul stench.

hunks.baseline: Just before the army set out, Jin Wikyung had been so busy he could barely find a moment to visit his quarters. The Big Man had been elsewhere, drinking with the Beggars’ Sect Leader and being invited to join the sect. When even that hadn’t worked out, he’d sent Jin Mukyung and other family members in his place, only to find the Big Man hiding with Cheongpung in the military supply warehouse, looking for snacks.
hunks.sol: Before the army set out, Jin Wikyung had barely found time in his hectic schedule to visit Great Sir’s quarters, only to discover he was elsewhere, drinking with the leader of the Beggars’ Sect and being invited to join. When Jin Wikyung sent Jin Mukyung and other family members in his place, they found Great Sir hiding with Cheongpung in the military provisions warehouse, looking for snacks.

hunks.baseline: And most people liked the Big Man.
hunks.sol: And most people liked Great Sir.

hunks.baseline: Even his youngest brother, whom Jin Wikyung thought just as finicky as his master, liked him.
hunks.sol: Even his youngest brother did—and Jin Wikyung thought Taekyung had a temperament as finicky as his master’s, for all that he loved him.

hunks.baseline: “The Big Man? I don’t know him that well, but from what I’ve seen, he seems like a good person.”
hunks.sol: “Great Sir? I don’t know him that well, but from what I’ve seen, he seems like a good person.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ve been watching him since Gansu, and, well, I’ve thought it over from every angle. I’ve got a good feeling about him. Like I do about you, hyung.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve been watching him since Gansu, and I’ve thought it over. I’ve got a good feeling about him. Like I do about you, hyung.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, right.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, right?”

hunks.baseline: “Of course. But, hyung, would you like some candy? Cheongpung left it behind.”
hunks.sol: “Of course. But hyung, want some candy? Cheongpung left it behind.”

hunks.baseline: That was the last time.
hunks.sol: That was as far as they’d gotten.

hunks.baseline: Time was pressing; a quarter hour felt like three autumns. Jin Wikyung grew busier still, while the Big Man continued darting all over the place like the wind.
hunks.sol: Time was pressing; fifteen minutes felt like three autumns. Jin Wikyung grew busier still, while Great Sir continued darting about like the wind.

hunks.baseline: And before long, the unprecedented combined army of the government and Murim split into three forces at the border between Qinghai and Xinjiang.
hunks.sol: Before long, the combined army of the government and Murim—the first of its kind in the continent’s history—split into three forces at the border between Qinghai and Xinjiang.

hunks.baseline: “…The candy was good.”
hunks.sol: “…That candy was good.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung found himself murmuring aloud. Then he noticed someone’s hot gaze on his cheek and straightened his expression.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung murmured without realizing it. Then he felt a hot stare on his cheek and composed his expression.

hunks.baseline: He was old, and even missing a leg, but he still had both ears, and his hearing was as sharp as ever.
hunks.sol: He was old and missing a leg, but he still had both ears, and his hearing was as sharp as ever.

hunks.baseline: He wanted to ask what candy Jin Wikyung had been enjoying so much, but the Thousand-Faced Fox once again put his years of experience to work and answered as calmly as he could.
hunks.sol: He wanted to ask what candy had been so delicious, but the Thousand-Faced Fox once again drew on his years of experience and answered as calmly as he could.

hunks.baseline: “If all has gone according to plan, they crossed Lop Nur fifteen days ago and should be reaching Hejing about now.”
hunks.sol: “If all has gone according to plan, they crossed Lop Nur fifteen days ago and should be at Hejing by now.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. The Tianshan Mountains are close. There may be a slight difference of a day or so, but they should be able to meet us at the foot of the range before sunset the day after tomorrow.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. Tianshan is close. We may be a day apart, but we should be able to join them at the edge of the Tianshan Mountains before sunset the day after tomorrow.”

hunks.baseline: The moment he heard the name, Jin Wikyung felt his hand tighten around the reins.
hunks.sol: The moment he heard the name, Jin Wikyung felt his grip tighten on the reins.

hunks.baseline: The lair of darkness, an unfathomable demon-slaying battleground that had poured forth countless evils over a thousand years, yet whose depths remained impossible to gauge.
hunks.sol: A demon-slaying battleground that had poured forth countless evils over a thousand years, yet still harbored a darkness whose depths no one could fathom.

hunks.baseline: They had arrived. At the end of this long journey, *he* was waiting.
hunks.sol: They had come. At the end of this long journey, *he* was waiting.

hunks.baseline: But before Jin Wikyung could calm the shiver of awe and fear that thought sent through him, a familiar voice rang out in the distance.
hunks.sol: Before Jin Wikyung could still the shiver of awe and fear that thought sent through him, a familiar voice rang out in the distance.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung’s eyes widened as his younger brother came hurtling toward him like an arrow, using his lightness skill. Where had he left the horse he’d treated like an extension of himself until now?
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung’s eyes widened as his younger brother came hurtling toward him alone like an arrow, using his lightness skill. Where had he left the horse he’d treated like an extension of himself until now?

hunks.baseline: A strange landscape spread behind Jin Mukyung’s approaching shoulder.
hunks.sol: An unfamiliar landscape spread behind Jin Mukyung’s approaching shoulder.

hunks.baseline: A natural formation that even the deep darkness couldn’t hide.
hunks.sol: A shape the deep darkness couldn’t conceal.

hunks.baseline: It loomed vast and immense beyond the driving rain.
hunks.sol: Beyond the driving rain, it was enormous. Vast.

hunks.baseline: But why?
Why was his heart pounding so hard? Why did Jin Mukyung’s voice sound so urgent?
hunks.sol: But why was his heart pounding so hard? Why did Jin Mukyung’s cry sound so urgent?

hunks.baseline: As the thunder boomed and a flash of light flared for an instant, the roars of countless monsters rang out.
hunks.sol: Thunder boomed. In the instant of light that followed, the roars of countless monsters rang out.
